name: The full-rules audit by object
result: A partner charging B in his lead's Chaos Unison now fires his own charged shot (both GBAs: "side 0's partner's charged B his own"), 3,123 iterations 0 apart, 456 rollbacks the same, partnerbreak=2 (the old rule on one GBA) apart from iteration 222; a partner's BN5 DarkChip darkens him in his own Souls' block (0x0203FFBE, 0x0203FFDE) and NaviStats (the effect slots 30 and 31), not his lead. The five BN5 chips the audit named never ask BN6's side-player getter (their copy of BN5's 0x080125EE, a side's player's chaos flag, is never called); BN5's Navis that ask stand in no NetBattle.
meaning: The Souls' and the mood's hooks are by object; a partner's UNITE has its block waiting. Nothing in a NetBattle aims at a side's player alone through the getter.
